kandra.title: Kandra — Recruitment Platform
kandra.description: Comprehensive HR platform connecting candidates, companies, and job offers with interactive dashboards and dynamic filters.
kandra.longDescription:
Kandra is a modern HR SaaS platform designed to transform and simplify the connection between candidates, companies, and recruiters. The project's goal was to create a comprehensive, smooth, and intuitive ecosystem capable of processing complex data flows while delivering a professional-grade user experience.

As a fullstack developer, I handled the overall application design from A to Z. On the backend and data side, I architected a robust PostgreSQL database modeled with Drizzle ORM, ensuring responsive queries and strict end-to-end typing with TypeScript. To provide an ultra-smooth navigation experience without page reloads, I integrated a smart client-side caching and automatic revalidation strategy using SWR.

The application features secure hybrid authentication (Google OAuth & JWT sessions), comprehensive analytical dashboards generating real-time statistics (application KPIs, job views, engagement metrics), as well as a responsive search engine with dynamic filters by job, industry, and region. A real-time notification system (dynamic Navbar badge and email alerts) instantly informs users of key recruitment milestones.

The ecosystem centers around 3 dedicated spaces:
- Candidate Space: profile management, 1-click application, job saving, and real-time tracking.
- Company Space: job posting, candidate pipeline management, and recruitment analytics.
- Admin Dashboard: account moderation, global platform monitoring, and taxonomy management.
features: Hybrid Authentication: Google OAuth & JWT (Email/Password)
Role Management (Talents, Companies, Admin)
Analytical Dashboards & Multi-profile Activity Stats
Search Engine & Filters by Sector, Job, and Region
Candidate Portal: Application Tracking & Job Saving

Admin Dashboard: Account Moderation & Taxonomy Management
Real-time Notification System (Navbar & Email Alerts)
Smart Cache Management with SWR (Smooth UI & Real-time)
Reactive PostgreSQL Databases

heartbeats.title: Heartbeats — Dating & Community Platform
heartbeats.description: High-traffic international community and dating web platform featuring real-time chat (WebSockets), multi-language support (8 languages), dark/light mode, and credit system.
heartbeats.longDescription:
Heartbeats is a high-traffic international dating and community platform developed at SK'HAY.

As a Fullstack Developer, I led all development stages: from UI/UX prototyping on Figma to implementing a decoupled architecture combining a robust Symfony backend (REST API) with MySQL, and a reactive frontend developed in React with Material UI (MUI). The project was managed as a team using GitLab for version control and integration.

The application offers a complete real-time experience via WebSockets (instant messaging, interaction notifications, likes, winks, virtual gifts), a credit-based monetary system with visibility boosts, full internationalization (i18n) in 8 languages, dark/light mode management, and advanced search based on geolocation and affinities.

Live Interactions: Likes, Winks, Virtual Gifts & Chat Requests

Robust Backend & Secure REST APIs Developed with Symfony

kitrana.title: Kitrana — Gamified Education Platform
kitrana.description: Gamified EdTech training and learning platform with code editor, progress tracking, badges, inventory, analytics, and OAuth authentication.
kitrana.longDescription:
Kitrana is a gamified online education platform designed to make technical learning engaging, measurable, and immersive.

I architected the entire fullstack setup from A to Z:
- Next.js (App Router) Frontend with React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind, and modern UI components (Radix / shadcn).
- Modular NestJS Backend with Prisma ORM, JWT + OAuth (Google / GitHub) authentication, strict validation, and email delivery.
- Gamified learner experience: achievements, inventory, scores, training time, progress, and analytical dashboards (Recharts).
- Technical training environment with a multi-language code editor (CodeMirror: JS, Python, PHP, Java, C++, SQL).

A central highlight of the project is the integration of Artificial Intelligence (Google Generative AI & Groq) into the pedagogical engine: learners' responses—whether free text or code—are automatically analyzed, corrected, and evaluated by AI. It assigns a score, detects logical errors, and provides personalized feedback, enabling autonomous learning without manual grading.

Data fetching is optimized via TanStack React Query (caching, revalidation, loading states), ensuring a smooth and responsive user experience across the platform.
features: Decoupled Fullstack Architecture: Next.js (frontend) + NestJS (API)
Automated Grading & AI-Powered Answer Evaluation (Google Gemini / Groq)
